The live application below is running completely client-side in your browser using serverless **Shinylive** (WebAssembly). You can interactively adjust substrate width, step density, toggle plant modules, and inspect spatial grid statistics.

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
inc_files <- c("R/triangle.R", "R/substrate_triangle.R", "R/triangleApp.R")

cat("```{shinylive-r}\n")
cat("#| standalone: true\n")
cat("#| viewerHeight: 750\n")
cat("#| components: [viewer]\n\n")

cat("library(shiny)\n")
cat("library(bslib)\n")
cat("library(ggplot2)\n")
cat("library(stats)\n\n")

for (f in inc_files) {
  fp <- file.path("..", f)
  if (file.exists(fp)) {
    lines <- readLines(fp, warn = FALSE)
    lines <- lines[!grepl("^\\s*#'", lines)]
    cat(paste0("# --- Auto-Included from ", f, " ---\n\n"))
    cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

cat("# --- Launch Application ---\n\n")
cat("triangleApp()\n")
cat("```\n")
```

---

## Programmatic Application Usage

Launch the interactive application natively in R:

```r
library(ewing)

triangleApp()
```
